author: Astrokillah
text:
I'm long bias on USDJPY since I saw price hit weekly support at around 105.55, saw price making HH, HL, HH, HL, took a trade today:

The more time I spent watching charts, the more I am realizing that ascertain a valid engulf is a lot more difficult than it sounds. Look closely at 1-min chart below.

Price hit a 15-min supply (green box), dropped, tested the 'bisque' color flag limit, and then engulfed south of it by less than 1 pip. When I first started in RTM, I would have considered this as a valid engulf signal, because price engulfed into the pole, it did not hit any kink, so normally I would be ready to take a short if price retrace up to the 15 min supply. But admittedly, I got burned too often by such 'fake signal'. Today, I was thinking in my head, no way, I'm long bias, this could easily be a fake out, so I instead of preparing to get out of the trade, I held on.

Below is another trade that I closed as price hit an opposing FL (bisque color zone), perhaps I have closed it too early, I'm really not sure, price engulfed the bisque color FL and bounced up a little, I would have taken a short right now if I am sure that this is a valid engulf, but I'm not sure. So I just have to be happy with what I got so far.

author: Astrokillah
text:
I have reached a milestone since Friday last week, the account has quadrupled, it started with 50k in January 2018, now it has grown above 200k. It took me 30 trading days, 50 calendar days to achieve this. Mostly with scalping:

But I know I cannot keep scalping forever. From now on, I'm going to focus on set-and-forget type of setups, I would use buy limit and sell limit order only, and once triggered, I won't look at the trade any more, it's either a win or a loss for me. I will be targeting only 3R in all my trades because my personally requires a win rate above 50%, less than that would ruin my confidence, if I aim for higher RR I'm sure my win rate will drop below 50%.

I'm going back to demo to test my success rate with set and forget. I would only trade my LIVE account minimally, with very small lots, just to cure my scalping 'itch' when I couldn't find set-and-forget (SAF) setups.

Below are two SAF winners.

Because trades are planned before price gets there, I have plenty of time to calculate my lot size, basically I risk 2% of my account on each trade, so every winner would give me +6%.
